newsitem.title: USA: Hughes buys Alliant marine unit.
newsitem.headline: Hughes buys Alliant marine unit.

text.p: Hughes Electronics Corp. said Monday it has acquired the Marine Systems Group unit of Alliant Techsystems Inc. for $141 million in cash.
The business employs about 650 workers in six states and will become part of Hughes unit Naval and Maritime Systems. Hughes said no workforce change is expected.
The Marine Systems Group, based in Mukilteo, Wash., makes torpedoes, underwater surveillance systems and mine neutralisation systems, and has about 650 employees in six states.
Hughes is a General Motors Corp. affiliate.
GM H Class stock, which reflects Hughes' performance, was unchanged at $59, while Minneapolis-based Alliant fell 25 cents to $43.375 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
